set.body: Write the performance ADR and receipt contract. Define the oracle ladder, mismatch minimization, comparator-bug handling, public end-to-end and prepared-topology boundaries, semantic checksums and tolerances, practical win/tie/loss thresholds, Tier-1 rows, memory and scaling rules, and immutable-source plus quiescent-host admission. No optimization result is admissible before this contract closes.
set.title: Freeze performance doctrine, comparator admission, and victory contract
